payload.title: Typed TypeScript client for kanbus-api (Node and browser)
payload.description: Publish a typed client (with @kanbus/ui or a sibling @kanbus/api-client package) for kanbus-api routes: query, get, create, update, delete, history, with If-Match revisions, X-Operation-Id idempotency, catalog_pending handling and typed errors (409 stale revision, 422 query_budget_exceeded). Types must match the exported KanbanIssue/KanbanConfig types. Release through the same ui-v (or a new) tag flow; see kbs-3307b32a item 5 for the publish channel.
